title: Penn State RB Nicholas Singleton would be a nice fit for the Broncos

sources.title: Penn State RB Nicholas Singleton would be a nice fit for the Broncos
sources.description: One prospect who may interest the Denver Broncos on day three of the 2026 NFL Draft is former Penn State running back Nicholas Singleton. He is a 6-0, 219-pound running back who is an intriguing size/speed option at the position that could be available for the Broncos in the 4th round of the draft. Singleton […]
